visualCharacteristics: A grid of four article cards. Each card is a linked tile with a cover image, a category tag pill, a date, and an H3 title. One column on mobile, two on tablet, four on desktop.
contentPattern: One row per card. Each row has an image cell and a body cell (category tag + date + title).
usage: Use for a 'latest articles' listing where each entry links to a blog post and shows its category, date, and title.
